about_the_game:
Welcome to Dusty Springs—a sleepy outback town where the mullets are long, the stubbies are cold, and the local bogans are louder than a magpie in mating season.

All is as it should be in Dusty Springs, until the nearby opal mine digs up more than just shiny rocks. These ain’t your average gems—they’re packed with spooky spirits and weird powers, warping the land and turning the local wildlife into beefed-up bush terrors.

Enter Drill and Thrill—a dodgy megacorp with more money than morals. They swoop in, snatch up the mine, and blame the locals for the chaos. Dusty Springs is locked down—no footy, no servo runs, and worst of all, no pub.

Meet Davo—proud bogan and pub regular. When his watering hole shuts, he’s had enough. With his thongs on and a heart full of sausage rolls, Davo sets out to save his town, expose Drill and Thrill, and maybe even punch a few drongos along the way.

What’s in the Demo

This demo gives you a taste of Davo’s bogan-powered adventure, including:

  • The first two areas of the game to explore and brawl through.

  • A chance to try out Davo’s early combat and movement.

  • The first boss battle, where you’ll put your skills (and your singlet) to the test.

What’s in the Full Game

The full Aussie Bogan Hero will include:

  • A sprawling 2D metroidvania adventure across iconic Aussie locations—from cursed opal mines to the Opera House.

  • Plenty more bosses, upgrades, and abilities.

  • True-blue laughs, pub-worthy banter, and an outback full of wild surprises.

So crack open a cold one, grab your thongs, and see if you’ve got what it takes to survive the demo.

content_descriptors.notes: mild cartoon violence. alcohol and tobacco use.

short_description: G’day mates! Aussie Bogan Hero is a crackin’ 2D metroidvania where Davo, a mullet-wearing legend, brawls corporate goons and mutated wildlife to save Dusty Springs. This demo includes the first two areas and the first boss battle, giving you a true-blue taste of the full adventure.
